shots.headline: 5 printable cheat sheets
shots.sub: Material settings, empty-spool weights, troubleshooting, bed adhesion and rules of thumb. One page each, Letter and A4 PDFs.

shots.headline: Filament settings by material
shots.sub: Sheet 1: nozzle and bed temperatures, enclosure, fan, speed, drying and density for PLA, PETG, ABS, ASA, TPU, nylon, PC and CF blends.

shots.headline: How much filament is left?
shots.sub: Sheet 2: empty-spool weights by brand, a worked example, grams to metres by material and weighing tips. A kitchen scale is all you need.

shots.headline: Symptom, cause, fix
shots.sub: Sheet 3: stringing, warping, layer shifts, under- and over-extrusion and more. Likely causes, the first fix to try, then the second.

shots.headline: Which surface for which material
shots.sub: Sheet 4: smooth and textured PEI, glass, garolite, tape and glue stick against each material, with bed temperatures and plate care.

shots.headline: Settings and pricing rules of thumb
shots.sub: Sheet 5: layer height versus nozzle, walls and infill for strength, what a print costs, and the numbers worth memorising.

faq.a: Instant download after purchase: two PDFs, one laid out for US Letter and one for A4.
Any home or office printer at 100% scale; black and white is fine. Each sheet is one page.

faq.q: What can I do with it?
faq.a: Personal use: print as many copies as you like for your own workshop. Please do not resell or share the files.

faq.q: Where do the numbers come from?
faq.a: Manufacturer guidance and the meshkit.pro materials and spool databases; sources are listed on each sheet.
Updated versions are added to the same listing; re-download from your Etsy purchases at no charge.
